Galaxy's Edge Series by Anspach and Cole - this series is very similar to Star Wars and Warhammer 40k put together.

Dusty's Diary by Bobby Adair - comedic short stories about the post apocalypse from the POV of a prepper. Toe fungus has infected the world creating bloodthirsty ShroomHeads

The Remaining Series by DJ Molles - post apocalyptic again, but interesting take with the main character specifically trying to rebuild society

The Heritage Trilogy, Legacy Trilogy and Inheritance Trilogy by Ian Douglas - 9 part series that takes place over a thousand years or so. These were my first ever adult science fiction books I read when I was a teen. Highly detailed and based on some real science with some conspiracies sprinkled in

Fated by SG Browne - story takes place from the perspective of the god of Fate. Interesting read, with bits of comedy thrown in.

Beyond Armageddon Series by Anthony DeCosmo - 8 alien factions have invaded Earth, we're trying to take it back. With a couple twists

The Dark Lights by michaelbren collings - horror/sci-fi from a hitmans perspective. Highly interesting read with a lot of time line jumps from chapter to chapter
